summary: Tested the new Results page and GET /api/bets/all, read-only (no bets were added, changed or deleted). Found and fixed a regression: in backend/bets.py, the new @r.get('/all') line had replaced the @r.post('/grade') decorator. That left POST /api/bets/grade unregistered, and the backend logs show 405s. ESPN auto-grading on Bet Tracker and /sean was silently broken because the frontend swallows the error. After restoring the decorator, the logs show POST /api/bets/grade returning 200. Backend: /api/bets/all returns 141 bets, oldest first, with no _id. /api/bets returns today's subset (0 today). Frontend: the Results tab has the lucide trending-up icon and opens /results; reload and back both work. With all books and all combos the stats are 141 bets, 5-131-5, -$101.10, -7.4% ROI, +97.4% avg EV, all matching an independent Python recompute. I checked every book filter (fd 25, dk 102, fan 105, mgm 15, hr 96) and the combo and book+combo combinations (6/6 all, 6/6 dk, 4/4 dk). Counts, record, profit and ROI match the recompute exactly. The odds column header changes to the book name. The FanDuel + 4+ Reb & 4+ Ast filter shows results-empty. Chart tooltip values match the expected running P/L (for example 6/6 dk: -$190, then $326.32, then $642.98). Rows are newest first. At 390px there is no page-level horizontal overflow; the table scrolls inside its container.

critical.issue: REGRESSION (FIXED by testing agent): adding @r.get('/all') removed the @r.post('/grade') decorator, so grade_bets was no longer a route and returned 405. Bet Tracker and SharedBets auto-grading silently failed. The decorator is restored and the route now returns 200.

issues: The combo Select trigger is w-56, so long labels get cut off (e.g. '6+ Rebounds & 6+ Assists (5'). Widen the trigger or let it size to its content.
On mobile the Results tab is the 5th item in the horizontal nav and is off-screen until you scroll the nav (minor).
The x-axis is the bet index (1..136), not a date, so you can't tell when swings happened. Consider date ticks or a date in the axis label.
type='monotone' smooths the step-like P/L jumps. type='linear' or 'stepAfter' would show them more accurately.

action_items: Keep the restored @r.post('/grade') decorator in backend/bets.py, and take care not to overwrite decorators when adding routes.
Optional: widen the combo filter trigger so labels aren't cut off.
Optional: add dates to the chart x-axis or tooltip header, and consider linear interpolation.
critical_code_review_comments: Results 'All books (avg)' EV uses the stored b.ev, which was computed with the settings in use when the bet was tracked. Per-book EV is recomputed with the current settings.singleHold and fees. Mixing these is a bit inconsistent but acceptable.
avgOdds averages every key in b.books, including both 'fd' (Odds API triple-double) and 'fd_sgp' for the same bet. The 'Book avg' column can therefore count a book twice.
/api/bets/all uses to_list(10000) with no pagination. That's fine now (141 bets) but is a hard cap.
Pending bets count toward 'Bets' but not the record or ROI, which is correct. Void bets show $0.00 P/L.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only testing; no bets were created, modified or deleted (status counts unchanged: 131 lost, 5 won, 5 void).
